company: Ryvqena Tech is a technology company focused on engineering intelligent digital solutions, developing software products and solving real-world problems. Tagline: Technology Beyond the Expected. The company is early in its journey and says so.

services.name: Web Development
services.text: Modern, responsive and scalable websites and web applications: company and product sites, web apps and dashboards, with accessibility, SEO and performance as defaults, plus APIs and integrations.

services.name: Artificial Intelligence
services.text: Intelligent solutions, automation and AI-powered systems: plain-language understanding, workflow automation and AI features inside existing products, with honest scoping of what AI can and cannot do.

services.name: Mobile Applications
services.text: Phone-first mobile apps for Android and iOS, with clear flows, touch-friendly design and low-bandwidth thinking.

services.name: Software Systems
services.text: Custom business and operations software: data models, reporting, workflows, secure and scalable foundations, with documentation and handover.

services.name: IT Consulting
services.text: Technology strategy and roadmaps, digital transformation planning, solution architecture review and practical vendor-neutral advice.

products.name: GariDoc
products.text: A vehicle health hub for drivers in Kenya. Describe a car problem in plain English or Swahili and get likely causes, an urgency label and a rough cost estimate in Kenyan shillings. It also decodes OBD-II fault codes, lists garages you can send a booking request to, keeps a service log with a QR code and sets reminders. Estimates are rough and a mechanic must inspect the car before any repair.

products.name: Vouchify
products.text: A digital vouching system: an institution issues a credential once and anyone who needs to trust it can check it instantly. It is in development and not available to the public yet.

products.name: Ryvqena Academy (Learning Hub)
products.text: A free learning area at #/academy with two beginner courses, AI and Machine Learning Fundamentals and Cloud Architecture Basics, each with four lessons and a quick check after every lesson. Passing all checks unlocks a printable certificate of completion, which is not an accredited qualification. Progress is saved in the visitor's own browser; there are no accounts yet.

products.name: EarthTrace
products.text: An environmental intelligence dashboard idea covering air quality, atmospheric composition, ocean health and biodiversity. It is a concept, not a released product.
